t: What he said watching a man's face go red
a: إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ كَلِمَةً لَوْ قَالَهَا لَذَهَبَ عَنْهُ مَا يَجِدُ لَوْ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
p: Innī la-aʿlamu kalimatan law qālahā la-dhahaba ʿanhu mā yajid. Law qāla: aʿūdhu bi-Llāhi mina-sh-shayṭāni-r-rajīm
m: I know a word which, if he said it, what he is feeling would leave him. If he said: I seek refuge in Allah from the rejected Satan.
